title: Staff Software Engineer/ Solution Architect
description:
At Epiq , your work contributes to complex, global legal outcomes. You ll join a values-driven community where integrity guides decisions, relentless service sets the bar, and we thrive on big challenges together. We invest in your growth with enterprise-wide learning and mobility. We celebrate who you are, and we respect life beyond work with flexibility that s recognized externally. Enabled by modern platforms and AI, you ll do the most meaningful work of your career and see your impact at scale. Summary We are seeking a highly skilled Staff Software Engineer/ Solution Architect - AI Solutions with strong expertise in Full Stack Software Development, Solution Design, Data Engineering, and AI/ML implementation. 
 This is a hands-on engineering role for an experienced software developer who combines strong technical design skills with recent experience building and deploying AI-powered applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing scalable solutions, contributing to software development, and implementing modern AI capabilities that align with our product and solution offerings. 
 As a Staff Software Engineer/ Solution Architect, you will work closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, leadership teams, clients, data scientists, consultants, DevOps engineers, and software engineers to design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and AI-driven solutions. You will play a key role in translating complex business problems into scalable technical solutions while ensuring engineering excellence, maintainability, and long-term product success. 
 Job Responsibilities Partner with business and product stakeholders to understand requirements, design end-to-end solutions, and help Product Owners break down initiatives into actionable user stories and technical deliverables. Design and develop scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions that can be integrated into existing products and strategic solution offerings. Actively contribute to software development, code reviews, technical design discussions, and architecture reviews. Drive solution design decisions while ensuring alignment with security, compliance, performance, and operational requirements. Leverage strong analytical and problem-solving skills to understand complex business challenges and develop innovative AI-powered solutions. Champion engineering best practices, coding standards, testing strategies, and quality metrics across development teams. Integrate and optimize data from various internal and external systems, understanding the challenges associated with enterprise data integration across SaaS applications. Design, develop, and maintain APIs, services, and integrations that support enterprise applications and AI solutions. Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies to improve scalability, maintainability, performance, and reliability of applications and AI systems. Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to ensure data quality, availability, and successful deployment of AI and machine learning capabilities. Design, implement, and maintain data pipelines, processing frameworks, and supporting infrastructure required for AI and machine learning workloads. Build and deploy AI-powered applications utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI frameworks, and modern AI orchestration patterns. Apply prompt engineering techniques and AI best practices to improve the quality, relevance, and reliability of generative AI solutions. Communicate technical solutions, risks, and recommendations effectively to leadership, business stakeholders, and clients. Stay current with advancements in software engineering, AI, machine learning, and cloud technologies, recommending practical innovations for our products and operations. Provide technical leadership, mentor team members, resolve complex technical challenges, and foster a collaborative engineering culture. 
 Requirements / Skills Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field. 12+ years of experience in Full Stack Software Development, Solution Design, Data Engineering, and AI/ML implementation. Strong hands-on software engineering background with proven experience designing and developing enterprise-scale applications. Demonstrated experience designing technical solutions and participating in architecture reviews, system design discussions, and technical decision-making. Advanced proficiency in Python and Java with strong experience building APIs, services, and distributed systems. Hands-on experience implementing and deploying Generative AI solutions in production environments. Strong understanding of LLMs, RAG architectures, Agentic AI, Prompt Engineering, MCP, A2A, and modern AI application development patterns. Experience working with NLP frameworks and machine learning libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, or similar technologies. Experience with cloud platforms and services including Azure and/or AWS. Experience with DevOps tools and practices including CI/CD pipelines, Terraform, AKS, EKS, GitHub Actions, and containerized deployments. Experience building modern user interfaces using React, Bootstrap, and related frameworks. Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Jira, and modern software delivery practices. Experience working with Snowflake, Databricks, and modern data platforms. Strong understanding of Data Integration, ETL, Data Quality, Data Discovery, and enterprise data management concepts. Experience integrating third-party and enterprise APIs. Familiarity with metadata management tools and data governance concepts. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to effectively engage clients, business stakeholders, leadership teams, and engineering organizations. title: Solution Architect
description:
osition: Solution Architect
 Experience: 12+ years
 Location: Ahmedabad / Hyderabad
 Time Zone/Shift: Starts at 12:30 PM IST
 
 12+ years of experience in software engineering, with strong experience in designing and architecting large-scale e-commerce applications.
 
 Role Overview 
 We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect to define and drive the technical architecture of a large-scale e-commerce platform. The candidate will work closely with engineering, product, DevOps, QA, and business teams to design scalable, secure, highly available, and maintainable solutions.
 The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with Java/Spring Boot, React, microservices, APIs, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , along with a solid understanding of modern e-commerce architecture.
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Define and maintain the end-to-end architecture for e-commerce applications across frontend, backend, APIs, integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
 Design scalable and highly available solutions using Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, and React .
 Define frontend architecture and best practices using React, TypeScript, state management, and reusable components .
 Design cloud-native solutions on GCP , considering scalability, reliability, security, performance, and cost optimization.
 Work with engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
 Define architecture standards, design patterns, coding standards, and technology guidelines.
 Review technical designs, architecture decisions, and implementation approaches.
 Identify technical risks, dependencies, and potential scalability or performance issues.
 Provide technical leadership and guidance to developers, leads, and engineering teams.
 Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD, infrastructure, observability, monitoring, and deployment strategies.
 Ensure solutions follow security, compliance, and enterprise architecture standards.
 Evaluate new technologies and recommend solutions that improve engineering productivity and application capabilities.
